success.title: TOUCHDOWN
lines: Dust settles. Silence. Then: the Moon, under your boots.
You made it. One of the last humans alive, and one of the first to call the Moon home.
success.kept: Your {item} is the first thing from Earth to touch the lunar surface.
success.consumed: Your {item} didn't make it. It's the reason you did.

rescue.title: ADRIFT
lines: {cause} We're drifting, a quiet spark between the Earth and the Moon.
Lunar Base picked up our beacon. Rescue is coming. Probably.
rescue.kept: You hold your {item} and watch the Moon, so close.
rescue.consumed: The pieces of your {item} are still keeping you alive.

failure.title: LOST
lines: The last rocket goes dark somewhere short of the Moon.
failure.kept: Somewhere out there, your {item} drifts on forever.
failure.consumed: You gave up your {item} for this ship. It almost worked.

causes.oxygen: The last of the air runs out.
